label: The Living Pyre first encounter

purpose.value: The sentient communal hearth that has warmed the Ashen people for millennia carries its voice to the cold threshold and issues the law's fair warning; the hero hears every word and misreads a lighthouse of home-fires as a demonic blaze. The guardian attempts communication first; the hero misreads it as a villain's taunt.

emotionalProgression.note: The guardian announces itself and its duty plainly, framed by hearths against the cold.
The warning was honest and complete; being ignored reads as insult.

notes: The scene MUST establish the guardian announcing itself and warning honestly — the law of fair warning means its attack paths will be shown, not hidden. The mercy exit (withdraw) is offered and never taken. Flavor: hearths against the cold. The player's view may hint the guardian's true role; the hero must not perceive it.
